result.topic_en: Riemann's method for the linear hyperbolic equation in characteristic variables p, q, expressing derivatives of w at a point (p',q') through boundary values and integrals with a Riemann function v = f(p-p', q-q') given as an exponential-times-series, together with jump/shock conditions relating densities and velocities across a discontinuity.
result.transcription:
$\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial q}\right)_{p',q'} = \left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial q} v\right)_{q'} + \int_{q'}^{p'} -v\,[-(\ldots)-]\,dp\ [-\ldots-]\frac{\partial w}{\partial q}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial q} - v\right) dq$
$\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial p}\right)_{p',q'} = \left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial p} v\right)_{p'} [-\pm-] + \int_{p'}^{q'} \frac{\partial w}{\partial q} dq\, v + \frac{\partial w}{\partial p} dp \left(v - \frac{\partial v}{\partial p}\right)$
$v = f(p-p', q-q') \quad f(p,q) = e^{p+q} \sum \frac{p^n q^n}{n!\,n!}$
$\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial q}\right)_{p',q'} = \left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial q} v\right)_{q'} - \int_{q',}^{p'} v \frac{\partial w}{\partial p} dp + \left(v - \frac{\partial v}{\partial q}\right) \frac{\partial w}{\partial q} dq$
$\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial p}\right)_{p',q'} = \left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial p} v\right)_{p'} - \int_{p'}^{q} \left(v \frac{\partial w}{\partial q} dq + \left(v - \frac{\partial v}{\partial p}\right) \frac{\partial w}{\partial p} dp\right)$

$\partial t [-\ldots-] v_1 \varrho_1 = \varrho_2 [-\ldots-] v_2 \partial t$
$a\omega(\varrho_1 - \varrho_2)\partial t = \partial t\, v_1 \varrho_1 (v_2 - v_1)$[?]
$= \varrho_1 a_1^2 \left(\frac{\varrho_1}{\varrho_2} - 1\right) \partial t$
$v_1 = \pm a \sqrt{\frac{\varrho_2}{\varrho_1}} = \frac{\partial x}{\partial t} - u_1$
$v_2 = \pm a \sqrt{\frac{\varrho_1}{\varrho_2}} = \frac{\partial x}{\partial t} - u_2$
$\frac{\partial x}{\partial t} = u_1 + a\sqrt{\frac{\varrho_2}{\varrho_1}} = u_2 + a\sqrt{\frac{\varrho_1}{\varrho_2}}$

$w_{p',q'} = v w_{(q',q')} + \int_{q',q}^{p',q} v\left(w + \frac{\partial w}{\partial p}\right) dp + w\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial q} - v\right) dq$
$f(p,q) = e^{p+q} \sum \frac{p^n}{n!} \frac{q^n}{n!}$
$v = f(p-p', q-q')$
